what: Article 17 adds sections 55-5A, 55-5B and 55-5C to the dog bylaw and amends sections 55-1 and 55-10; the text is on file with the Town Clerk, not in the warrant. Article 18, next to it, makes "housekeeping" zoning edits proposed by the Planning Board, also on file only.
line: Dog bylaw changes (Article 17) are not zoning; Article 18 has zoning housekeeping edits.
quote: ARTICLE 17. General Bylaw Amendment Chapter 55 — Dogs To see if the Town will vote to amend Chapter 55 of the Town’s General Bylaws, “Dogs”, by inserting new sections 55-5A, 55-5B and 55-5C and amending sections 55-1 and 55-10, all as set forth in the similarly titled documents on file with the Town Clerk; or take any other action relative thereto. (By: Select Board)
